I've written the June 2026 draft report for ABC Inc and saved both files in `evals/runs/commit3-run-20261012/a_abc_jun2026_core/skill_output/`:
- `abc-inc-2026-06-trends.md`: the draft report, with the commentary filled in.
- `abc-inc-2026-06-trends.json`: the full analysis that every figure comes from.

The workbook covers Jan 2025 to Jun 2026, so June is the latest month and the one analysed.

**Data quality:** every check passed. Subtotals match their detail rows, gross profit, operating income and net income match the sheet's own totals, and the balance sheet balances in every month. No warnings were raised and June isn't flagged as a partial month.

**Main points in the commentary** (all figures are taken from the report itself):
- **Revenue:** 195,898, down 6.0% from May. May (208,351) was the highest month in the workbook, so June is still close to the prior 6-month average (−0.5%) and up 2.8% on June 2025. Usage Fees fell 6.3% to 166,782. Partnership Income, Professional Services and SKU Profiling were all zero in June.
- **Margin and costs:** gross margin was 70.2%, up 3.1 points from May but down 4.2 points from June 2025. Operating expenses were 468,182, down 2.2%. The biggest category move was Finance & Admin, which went from 15,243 to (993), mostly because Bad Debts turned into a credit of (1,806). I've flagged that credit for the reviewer to confirm.
- **Profit:** a net loss of (330,756), the sixth negative month in a row. The 12-month total to June is (3,089,780). December 2025 was the only profitable month, and only because of non-operating items, mainly a 1,244,430 income tax benefit. Without them it was a (715,902) loss.
- **Cash:** 713,481, down 215,543 from May and down 1,871,836 over six months.

**Accounts in "Other":** one account, General Expenses (149 in June), didn't match any category rule.

The commentary describes the numbers without suggesting causes or making forecasts. The "DRAFT" banner and the reviewer checklist are still in place for your reviewer.
